canonical_statement: The fundamental substance of the universe is mental in nature.

attributions.surface_quote: The Universe being wholly mental.

canonical_statement: Mastery over reality is achieved by aligning with universal laws rather than opposing them.

attributions.surface_quote: The wise man falls in with the Law... he operates it instead of being its slave.

canonical_statement: Phenomena and environmental conditions can be altered through the application of mental power.

attributions.surface_quote: True Hermetic Transmutation is a Mental Art.

canonical_statement: All individual beings, regardless of their level of wisdom, remain subject to universal law.

attributions.surface_quote: Both swimmer and log; wise man and fool, are subject to Law.
